issues.title: Update node to 16
issues.body:
For another project I wanted to use `yarn create react-app`.  But, it doesn't support our old version of node (`14`).

When I tried to update my local node to 16 (the current LTS), Serge wouldn't build because it requires node `14`.  I updated the version in the top-level `package.json` to 16, but then `sass` failed.

This issue is to update the Serge requirement of node to `16`, and resolve dependency problems which follow that.
